theater: 寧夏中衛黃河左岸好水川

battle.name: 好水川之戰
battle.theater: 寧夏中衛黃河左岸好水川
battle.brief: 一〇四一年康定二年春，西夏元昊再犯渭州，宋將曹瑋迎戰於好水川河谷。宋軍以蹶張弓、霹靂弓與牀子弩築成箭幕擋住夏軍精騎，再以車陣分割敵陣、精騎掩擊，夏軍大潰，斬首數千級。此役縱火只靠火箭與火障；卡面的拜占庭希臘火同樣以火阻騎，卻從未東傳。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是北宋與西夏。一〇三八年西夏主元昊稱帝建大夏，定都興慶府，此後連年向宋境用兵，一〇四〇年二月在鄜州三川口大破宋軍，兵鋒隨即逼近環慶與渭州一線。宋朝在陝西設四路，環慶、鄜延、秦鳳、熙河各有軍兵與堡寨，仁宗朝以陝西經略安撫使節制全局，時夏竦任宣撫使，范仲淹以副使兼知延州襄贊軍務，前線由各州守臣分擔：曹瑋出知渭州，主持秦鳳線的守禦，麟州折氏的折惟恭等分守沿邊城寨，另有吐蕃與羌人組成的蕃兵、邊民充任的弓箭手與募來的步卒。宋軍步多騎少，因西北缺馬，全線只能靠堡寨、弓弩與屯田撐住，軍糧多由秦鳳、熙河的屯田與關中車隊轉運供應。西夏一側由元昊自領中樞，令漢臣張儼、野利仁榮等掌尚書與出使文書，軍隊以涼州、靈州一帶牧場出來的馬匹立國，步兵在前列陣，鐵鷂子精騎居中衝鋒，兩翼以輕騎包抄，糧秣靠涼州與河套的屯墾加上就地掠奪。西夏屢勝之際，北方又與契丹保持往來，宋以澶淵之盟牽制遼，夏則周旋於宋、遼之間，三方之間這道夾縫正是這場戰役的背景。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Northern Song and Western Xia. In 1038 the Xia ruler Yuanhao proclaimed himself emperor and founded the Great Xia state at Xingqing; from then on he campaigned into Song territory year after year, crushing the Song army at Sanchuankou in Fuzhou in the second month of 1040, and his spearhead then pressed towards the Huanqing and Weizhou lines. The Song organised Shaanxi into four circuits — Huanqing, Fuyan, Qinfeng and Xihe — each with its own garrison and forts, and the court in the reign of Emperor Renzong put the whole theatre under a commissioner for the pacification and defence of Shaanxi; Xia Song then held that post, with Fan Zhongyan as deputy commissioner and governor of Yanzhou assisting in the military affairs, and the forward positions were held by the commanders of the frontier prefectures: Cao Wei governed Weizhou and directed the defence of the Qinfeng line, Zhai Weigong of the Linzhou house of Zhai held frontier towns on his side, and there were also auxiliaries drawn from the Tibetans and Qiang, bowmen taken from the border population, and recruited infantry. The Song army was heavy on foot and light on horse, because horses were scarce in the north-west; the whole line could be held only on forts, crossbows and garrison farms, and the grain came mainly from the military farms of Qinfeng and Xihe and from waggon convoys out of Guanzhong. On the Xia side the centre was Yuanhao himself, with Han officials such as Zhang Yan and Ye Li Renrong handling the ministry and the diplomatic correspondence; the army rested on horses from the pastures around Liangzhou and Lingzhou, put infantry in front, kept the armoured iron-vult horse in the centre to charge, and sent light horse on both wings to envelop, while its supplies came from the settlements of Liangzhou and Hetao and from foraging on the spot. Even as Xia kept winning, it was in contact with the Khitan to the north; the Song held the Liao in check under the Chanyuan treaty while Xia moved between the two, and that triangular space is the background of this battle.
people: 好水川的主帥是曹瑋，字寶臣，出自曹彬一族的將門，《宋史》為他立有專傳。康定年間他出守渭州，掌秦鳳線的兵權。此戰的關鍵在曹瑋不把主力壓在城裏，而是率兵出城迎敵，把弩手排在最前，等夏軍精騎逼近到弩箭射程之內才放箭，再用車陣與拒馬把敵騎的衝鋒線切斷；待夏軍氣勢稍挫，他立刻以精騎自側翼掩擊，掩擊之後不急著收兵，而是一路追到敵營，把繳獲的牛羊與器械一併帶走。曹瑋治軍嚴，軍期一到不許後退，違期者斬，這條軍令使數千人的步卒隊在夏軍十萬之眾面前沒有先崩。另一端的元昊自領大軍，把鐵鷂子的衝力與人數優勢全押在一次衝鋒上，卻在箭幕與車陣前折了銳氣，遠征失敗的後果由部將與參議承擔。西夏一側主持文牘與和議的是漢臣張儼與野利仁榮。宋這邊最有影響力的第三人其實不在前線：陝西經略安撫副使范仲淹，好水川得勝的消息傳回汴京後，他在同年十一月遞上答手詔條陳十事，正式提出冊封元昊、議和的方案，與曹瑋的主張互相呼應。宣撫使夏竦則持相反意見，認為一勝不足以言和，兩人此後在廷議上互相攻訐，政爭的伏線就埋在那時。
peopleEn: The commander at Haoshuichuan was Cao Wei, courtesy name Baochen, out of the military clan of Cao Bin; the History of Song has a separate biography for him. In the Kangding years he governed Weizhou and held the command on the Qinfeng line. The crux of the battle lay in his decision not to pile his strength inside the city walls but to march out and meet the enemy: he put the crossbowmen in front and held fire until the Xia cavalry had come inside the effective range of the bolts, then used waggons and caltrops to cut the line of the enemy charge; and the moment the Xia attack wavered, he sent his own horse round the flank, and after the counter-stroke did not stop to consolidate but pursued the enemy to its camp and carried off the captured cattle, sheep and equipment. Cao Wei's army was strict: the day appointed was the day the line moved, and those who came late were beheaded, and that rule held several thousand infantry together in the face of an enemy said to be a hundred thousand strong. At the other end Yuanhao led his army in person and staked everything on the impact of the iron-vult horse and on numbers in a single charge, and it was his own leadership that lost its edge before the arrow wall and the waggon line; the consequences of his campaign were carried by his subordinates and advisers. On the Xia side the documents and the peace negotiations were handled by Han officials such as Zhang Yan and Ye Li Renrong. The third man who shaped this battle was not on the battlefield at all: Fan Zhongyan, deputy commissioner for Shaanxi, who after the news of the victory reached Bianjing submitted the Reply to the Imperial Edict with Ten Articles in the eleventh month of the same year, formally proposing that Yuanhao be invested as Prince of Xia and that terms be negotiated, a line that matched Cao Wei's own view. The commissioner Xia Song took the opposite position, arguing that one victory was not enough to talk peace; the two men attacked each other in court afterwards, and the seed of that political feud was laid then.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火屬於拜占庭帝國，約七世紀起配在青銅管中噴射，是稠厚難以點熄的燃燒劑，帝國把配方列為最高機密，傳說配方隨沉船一同失落，此後再沒有第二套辦法。它的戰術任務只有一個：用火封住正在移動的對手，點燃敵船的燃料，使進攻方失去動力而不能靠岸；因為管口有限、射程有限，它從來不是野戰的投射兵器，而是船首與城牆上的近距離阻斷工具。卡面沒有出現在好水川，原因很直接：這套裝備與配方從未離開拜占庭，中亞與宋境沒有任何一條線索顯示它東來。〇四一年宋軍手裡真正能對付騎兵的是弩。蹶張弓要兩三人用腳蹬開弓弦，發出的箭又重又直，專為射穿夏軍的皮甲札葉；霹靂弓的弓臂更長更有力，張力遠勝尋常角弓；牀子弩架在車上，能連發，是宋軍壓制衝鋒骨幹的倚重。步卒持長槍大刀結陣，車輛裝成拒馬擋住騎兵，糧秣與箭矢靠橐車隨軍搬運，弓弩不足時以火矢射擊騷擾，夏軍最重的鐵鷂子反覆撞擊車陣，每撞一次，宋軍的箭就多一層。當時更沒有火砲，北宋的火藥武器還停留在投擲的火箭與火球，液態的燃燒劑更是從未聽聞。希臘火與火箭的分別不在火本身，而在那支銅管：一支能連續噴出黏稠火焰，一支只能射出一支燒著的箭。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on this card belongs to the Byzantine Empire. From about the seventh century it was projected from bronze tubes, and it was a thick burning fluid that was hard to put out; the empire kept the formula as its highest secret, and the story is that it was lost with a ship that sank, so that no second way of producing it was ever found. Its tactical task was a single one: to use fire to stop a target that was moving, to set alight the fuel of an enemy ship and rob the attacker of the motive power he needed to come alongside. Because the bore was small and the reach short, it was never a field weapon but a close-range blocking tool mounted on ship bows and on city walls. It did not appear at Haoshuichuan for a plain reason: neither the equipment nor the formula ever left Byzantium, and no thread of evidence connects them with Central Asia or with Song territory. What the Song army actually held in 1041 against cavalry was the crossbow. The treading bow needed two or three men to draw the string with their feet, and it threw a heavy, straight shaft designed to pierce the leather and lamellar armour of the Xia; the thunder bow had a longer and more powerful arm and far more tension than an ordinary horn bow; the bed crossbow was set up on a waggon and could fire in sequence, and it was the mainstay of the Song effort against the charge. The infantry closed up with long spears and broadswords, waggons were ranged in as movable barricades to hold the horse back, and food and arrows travelled on baggage carts with the army; when the bows ran short, fire-arrows were used to harass. The heavy Xia iron-vult horse collided again and again with the waggon line, and each collision added one more layer of arrows to the Xia. There were no cannon: Northern Song gunpowder weapons were still limited to thrown fire-arrows and fire-balls, and a liquid burning fluid was simply unheard of. The difference between Greek fire and a fire-arrow is not the fire itself but the tube: one spits a stream of burning fluid, the other shoots a single shaft that is alight.
tactics: 宋軍的接戰程序是這樣的：先以步卒與蕃兵結陣，把橐車橫列在陣前當作活動拒馬，弩手分列兩翼，數百步之內不發一矢，等夏軍前陣步兵逼近到箭雨能覆蓋的距離才齊射，把敵陣前段射得立足不穩。夏軍精騎隨即發動衝鋒，想靠速度撕開缺口，宋軍不與其纏鬥，只以弩箭和車陣拖住，等騎兵衝勢用盡、隊形散開，曹瑋才下令精騎自側後掩擊，把被車陣困住的敵騎往河谷低處趕，兩翼同時截斷退路。整個過程是先弩後騎，並非宋軍騎兵比夏軍強，而是宋軍用箭幕和地形換取騎兵衝鋒的一次性代價。地形是第二個關鍵：好水川是黃河左岸一條西北走向的河谷，谷寬有限，兩側是坡地與土壘，春天水淺、車輛能過，夏軍重騎一旦陷進鬆軟河灘就再也衝不起來。掩護方面，車陣同時是弩手的盾牌、拒馬的骨架和箭箱的掩體，傷兵可以退到車陣後方集中救治。補給靠兩條線：秦鳳、熙河沿邊的屯田供糧，關中以車隊運糧到前線堡寨，戰役本身只打一日到數日，隨軍帶數日之糧，撐得過去。紀律上，曹瑋嚴格執行軍期，規定交戰時刻與撤退信號，違者按軍法處置，這使宋軍在絕對劣勢下沒有先崩。追擊階段則派輕騎續行，把潰散的敵騎往遠處趕，順勢截下丟棄的牛羊與器械。
tacticsEn: The Song order of approach was this: infantry and the Tibetan auxiliaries formed up first, baggage waggons were ranged in front of the line as movable barricades, crossbowmen were posted on both flanks, and not a shaft was loosed for several hundred paces; only when the Xia infantry in front came within the distance the arrow fall could cover did the line loose together and leave the leading edge of the enemy unable to plant its feet. The Xia heavy horse charged at once, hoping to tear a gap with speed, and the Song did not try to hold them in a melee but simply used bolt and waggon to hold them, until the charge had spent itself and the formation had come apart; only then did Cao Wei order his own horse round the flank and rear, driving the trapped riders down into the low ground of the valley while both wings cut off the retreat. The whole sequence was bolts first and horse second: it was not that the Song horse was better than the Xia horse, but that the Song traded the one-off cost of a cavalry charge for arrow wall and ground. The second key was the ground itself. Haoshuichuan is a river valley running north-west on the left bank of the Yellow River, of limited width and flanked by slopes and earth banks, shallow enough in spring for waggons to cross; once the heavy Xia horse was bogged in the soft sand of the river flats it could never charge again. As cover, the waggon line was at once a shield for the crossbowmen, the frame of the barricade and a screen for the arrow boxes, and the wounded could be pulled back behind it for treatment. Supply ran on two lines: the military farms along the Qinfeng and Xihe borders produced the grain, and convoys of waggons carried it from Guanzhong to the forward forts; the fighting itself lasted a day or a few days, the army carried only as many days of rations as that, and that was enough to get through it. On discipline, Cao Wei enforced the appointed time rigidly, fixing the hour of engagement and the signal for withdrawal and applying the articles of war to any who broke it, and that is why the Song line did not collapse first despite being outnumbered many times over. In the pursuit stage light horse was sent on to keep up the chase, drive the scattered riders away, and pick up the cattle, sheep and equipment the enemy threw away.
data: 留下數字的只有《宋史·曹瑋傳》短短一段。兵力方面，書中稱元昊率眾十萬來寇，這是宋人對西夏大軍的慣用概數，實際到陣的步騎當在數萬之數，作戰骨幹是精騎；曹瑋一方是蕃兵與弓箭手為主的數千人，其中可用於掩擊的精騎數量有限，兵力對比在二十比一以上。損失記為斬首數千級，虜棄牛羊萬餘，器械盡棄，追擊一直打到敵營之外——這說明夏軍不是被擊退而是崩潰，連同輜重一起被捲走。戰役本身規模不大，歷時一至數日，沒有攻城戰，也沒有大屠傷。器械方面，蹶張弓與霹靂弓的有效射程在數百步，牀子弩的射程略近但射速高，配在車上架設；宋軍的馬匹數量遠少於夏軍，掩擊用的精騎多靠邊軍就地湊集。其他數字未必可靠：雙方具體死傷、各部損失比例、戰役確切日期（該戰只記在康定二年春）等都無法從現存記載中確定。好水川的具體位置亦有兩說，一般以寧夏中衛一帶黃河左岸的苦水河上游為準，另有考據指在陝西定邊、靖邊一帶，兩說相去不遠，都在夏人南下的通道上。放回整條戰線看：好水川之前是一〇四〇年二月鄜州三川口之敗，之後是一〇四二年定川寨再失，一〇四四年慶曆和議訂下宋夏邊界。卡面那件兵器則更早，約六七八至六七九年的君士坦丁堡之圍中使用，此後配方失傳，此戰與它無涉。
dataEn: The only figures that survive come from the short passage in the biography of Cao Wei in the History of Song. On strength, the book says Yuanhao came with a hundred thousand men; that is the customary round number Song writers used for a Xia army, and the troops actually in the line were certainly fewer — some tens of thousands, with the armoured horse as the fighting core. Cao Wei's side numbered several thousand, mostly Tibetan auxiliaries and bowmen, with only a limited body of horse available for the counter-stroke, so the ratio was worse than twenty to one. Losses are recorded as several thousand severed heads, with the enemy abandoning more than ten thousand head of cattle and sheep and leaving all their equipment behind, and the pursuit ran on to beyond the enemy camp — which tells us the Xia army was not merely repelled but broken, and swept up with its baggage. The action itself was small, lasting from a day to a few days, with no siege and no great slaughter. On equipment, the effective range of the treading bow and the thunder bow was several hundred paces; the bed crossbow was somewhat shorter in reach but faster, and was set up on waggons; the Song had far fewer horses than the Xia, and the horse used for the counter-stroke was gathered locally along the frontier. Other numbers are not reliable: the exact casualties on both sides, the losses of each arm, and the precise date — the battle is placed only in the spring of the second year of Kangding — cannot be fixed from what survives. The exact location of Haoshuichuan too has two readings; the usual one puts it on the upper reaches of the Kushui river on the left bank of the Yellow River near Zhongwei in Ningxia, while another places it in the Dingbian or Jingbian area of Shaanxi, and the two are not far apart, both lying on the road by which the Xia moved south. Placed in the wider frame: before Haoshuichuan came the Song defeat at Sanchuankou in Fuzhou in the second month of 1040; after it came the loss of Dingchuanzhai in 1042 and the Chanyuan settlement of 1044, which set the Song-Xia boundary. The weapon on the card is far older still, used in the siege of Constantinople of about 678-679, and its formula was lost afterwards; it had nothing to do with this battle.
cause: 打起上來的根由是西夏把秦鳳、渭州這條路當作必爭之地。元昊一〇三八年建國之後就以關中為目標，一〇三九年冬在延州擊殺宋將劉平、石元，一〇四〇年又失保安軍，二月在鄜州三川口擊潰宋軍，陝西人心震動。宋廷派范仲淹出任陝西經略安撫副使，夏竦為宣撫使，把整頓邊防的任務交給二人；范仲淹到任後修城築寨、練兵屯田，主張以有形防禦換取談判籌碼。曹瑋在渭州一線整軍，重點放在弓弩、堡寨與訓練上，招募蕃兵與邊地弓箭手，湊出能與夏軍鐵鷂子正面對抗的步弩陣。一〇四一年春，夏軍再犯渭州，這次傾力而來，元昊指望重演三川口的全勝，卻遇到一支已經不打算在城下硬碰的宋軍。導火索看似是邊境的一次入寇，本質是兩個政權對關中控制權的爭奪：夏要的是渭州通向靈州的通道與沿邊牧場，宋要的是保住關中門戶，讓經略使的整軍有時間完成。糧道與馬匹的差距，使宋軍只能打一場短促而精確的會戰，曹瑋選擇了這一種打法。
causeEn: The root of the fighting lay in Western Xia's determination to hold the road through Qinfeng and Weizhou. After founding his state in 1038 Yuanhao set his sights on Guanzhong: in the winter of 1039 he took Yanzhou and killed the Song generals Liu Ping and Shi Yuan, he lost Bao'an in 1040, and in the second month of that year he crushed the Song army at Sanchuankou in Fuzhou, and the shock ran through the whole Shaanxi front. The court sent Fan Zhongyan as deputy commissioner for Shaanxi, with Xia Song as commissioner, entrusting them with the reform of the frontier defence; Fan arrived, repaired walls, built forts, trained troops and opened farms, arguing that visible defences were the way to buy room for negotiation. Cao Wei, on the Weizhou line, reorganised his troops around crossbows, forts and training, recruiting Tibetan auxiliaries and local bowmen to assemble an infantry-and-crossbow formation that could stand up to the Xia iron-vult horse. In the spring of 1041 the Xia army invaded Weizhou once more, coming with everything, for Yuanhao expected to repeat the total victory of Sanchuankou; what he met was a Song army that no longer intended to trade blows in front of its own walls. The spark looks like a border raid, but the substance is a struggle between two polities over control of Guanzhong: Xia wanted the road from Weizhou to Lingzhou and the pastures along the frontier, Song wanted the gateway of the central plain held shut long enough for the commissioner's programme to take hold. The gap in horses and in supply allowed the Song only one kind of battle, a short and precise meeting engagement, and Cao Wei chose to fight that way.
impact: 這一勝的意義大過戰果本身。曹瑋用一場會戰把「宋軍不能打」的說法推翻，陝西防線的士氣與朝議的氣勢都因此改變；范仲淹提出議和時，手上已有一份能拿得出手的戰報，同年十一月他上答手詔條陳十事，主張認封元昊為夏國主、歲賜銀絹、劃定邊界，讓邊境由打轉為守。宣撫使夏竦反對，一〇四三年范仲淹被調離陝西，議和一度擱置，但一〇四四年的慶曆和議仍然以他提出的框架達成，此後宋夏之間維持近二十年的相安局面，直到一〇六〇年代再起干戈。就戰術而言，此役確立了一條與卡面兵器恰好相反的路徑：拜占庭用銅管裡的希臘火把敵船點成火炬，好水川的宋軍用弓弩、車陣和火矢把敵騎困在河灘上；同樣是以火與器械改變對手的移動，一個靠工藝奇技，一個靠體系與紀律。宋朝此後在西北的建設重心落在堡寨、屯田與弓弩制度上，這些才是能年年複製的東西。
impactEn: The significance of this victory was greater than its results. Cao Wei used a single engagement to overturn the assumption that the Song could not fight, and both the mood on the Shaanxi front and the temper at court changed with it. When Fan Zhongyan proposed negotiations he now had a report he could put in front of the throne, and in the eleventh month of the same year he submitted the Reply to the Imperial Edict with Ten Articles, urging that Yuanhao be invested as Prince of Xia, that silk and silver be paid to him yearly, and that a boundary be drawn, so that the frontier turned from fighting to holding. The commissioner Xia Song opposed this; in 1043 Fan Zhongyan was transferred away from Shaanxi and the talks stalled for a while, but the Chanyuan settlement of 1044 was still reached on the framework he had set out, and the two states kept the peace for nearly twenty years afterwards, until the wars of the 1060s. In tactical terms this battle set a course that is the exact opposite of the weapon on the card: Byzantium turned enemy ships into burning torches with Greek fire in a bronze tube, while the Song army at Haoshuichuan pinned the enemy horse on the river flats with crossbows, waggons and fire-arrows. Both were ways of using fire and machinery to change the movement of the other side — one relying on a technical marvel, the other on organisation and discipline. What the Song built afterwards in the north-west was forts, farms and a crossbow system, and those were the things that could be repeated year after year.
result: 結果是宋軍全勝而夏軍崩潰：元昊所部在好水川河谷被射散，斬首數千級，棄牛羊萬餘，器械盡棄，部眾退回夏州方向，渭州與鄜延兩線同時轉穩；曹瑋乘勝收束秦鳳線的堡寨與糧道，把這一勝固定成可防守的地形，而不是一次性的戰果。此後宋夏戰線上再沒有決定性的單場會戰能改變局面：好水川之後，夏軍一年內再攻渭州方向即受阻，兩年內定川寨一度失守又重修；大順、嘉祐年間宋夏再啟戰端時，雙方已定型為長期的邊境消耗戰，靠堡寨、屯田與互市維持平衡。對西夏來說，這一敗迫使元昊正視宋廷的實力，把精力從進一步攻宋轉向穩定境內與維持與契丹的關係，最終走向慶曆和議。對宋來說，好水川是日後能以議和收場的資本。關於卡面這件兵器，可以確定的只有一句：希臘火與好水川沒有任何關係，它的配方在七世紀末已隨拜占庭的沉船失落，此後不曾再現；此戰真正決定勝負的，是弩手的射準、車陣的組合和臨陣的決斷。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Song victory and a collapse of the Xia army. Yuanhao's troops were shot apart in the valley of Haoshuichuan, several thousand severed heads were taken, more than ten thousand head of cattle and sheep were abandoned with all the equipment, and the survivors withdrew towards Xia Prefecture, leaving both the Weizhou and the Fuyan lines steady at once. Cao Wei pressed the advantage by tightening the forts and the supply roads of the Qinfeng line, converting the victory into defensible ground rather than a one-off result. After this, no single decisive engagement on the Song-Xia front could change the situation: a renewed Xia attack on the Weizhou line was stopped within a year, and Dingchuanzhai was lost and rebuilt within two; and when Song and Xia opened hostilities again in the Dashun and Jiayou years, both had settled into a long attritional struggle along the frontier, balanced by forts, farms and mutual trade. For Western Xia the defeat forced Yuanhao to face the real strength of the Song court, and he turned from further conquest in the east to consolidating his own territory and maintaining relations with the Khitan Liao, which finally led to the Chanyuan settlement. For the Song, Haoshuichuan was the capital that made a negotiated peace possible. As for the weapon on this card, only one thing can be said with certainty: Greek fire had nothing to do with Haoshuichuan. Its formula was lost with the Byzantine ship in the late seventh century and never reappeared, and what actually decided this battle was the accuracy of the crossbowmen, the composition of the waggon line, and the decisiveness of the men on the spot.
